summary: Wolfspeed filed a Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 on September 16, 2026, furnishing unaudited pro forma consolidated financial information as Exhibit 99.1. The disclosure gives effect to the company's prepackaged plan of reorganization effective September 29, 2025, adoption of fresh start accounting under ASC 852, and receipt of Regulatory Approvals on January 29, 2026. No new transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation or advisor is stated; the filing is a retrospective accounting presentation of an already-consummated Chapter 11 emergence, so it constitutes no new special situation. Watch for any subsequent strategic or capital-structure actions post-emergence.
